svg.title: Clavicula Graduum - Tabula IX - The Square Table
svg.desc: Two inks, centerline serif paths (EMS Nixish), no raster or fills. Labels at least 2.5 mm nominal H cap. Cipher: base shift +3 modulo 12, tally unchanged. Red rings assign stations 0-6 to shifts 00-06. A4. Untested on a physical plotter.
